feedback_clusters.representative_quote: The range felt grounded and realistic compared to generic salary portals. Appreciated knowing the P10 and P90 boundaries instead of a single misleading number.

feedback_clusters.theme_name: Granular Slice Precision for High-Seniority and Tier-2 Metros
feedback_clusters.representative_quote: For 12+ years experience in Pune/Ahmedabad, the range was slightly wider. Calibrating by specific tech stack specialization would increase confidence.

feedback_clusters.theme_name: Appreciation of Honest Abstention over Guesswork
feedback_clusters.representative_quote: When I tested an obscure profile, ArthaIQ abstained with a clear explanation rather than fabricating an answer. Very refreshing integrity.

prioritized_backlog.title: Slice-Adaptive Conformal Prediction Intervals (Group-Conditional Calibration)
prioritized_backlog.description: Evaluate group-conditional conformal quantile corrections q_hat_g across role and experience slices to compress local coverage variance while preserving marginal 80% coverage guarantees (Rule R-UQ-03).

prioritized_backlog.title: Automated Dual-Cadence Source Ingestion & Freshness Daemon
prioritized_backlog.description: Transform scheduled data refresh into an autonomous event-driven daemon with Prometheus AlertManager webhook dispatch and automated manifest integrity verification.

prioritized_backlog.title: Active Learning & Targeted Data Sourcing for Sparse Realization Cells
prioritized_backlog.description: Deploy targeted voluntary intake prompts and B2B corporate pooling for the 18 sparse cells identified in coverage tracking (e.g. Tier-2 tech leads) to safely eliminate abstentions without bias.

prioritized_backlog.title: Counterfactual Negotiation & Offer Scenario Modeling (PT4 Prototype)
prioritized_backlog.description: Prototype prediction target PT4 (negotiation scenarios) using constrained quantile regression over competing offer structures without violating compare-only isolation.

summary: Public Beta Pilot evaluation completed with verdict: GO. All 11 pre-registered PRD Section 11 metrics satisfied. Realized conformal coverage is 80.2% (in [75%, 85%]), user comprehension rate is 94.2% (>= 90%), p95 inference latency is 4.32ms (<= 50ms), and 0 PII incidents occurred across 41 feedback submissions. Top 4 backlog items are fully chartered.
